exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Not as much/less than".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
A より B のほうが〜
options.romaji: A yori B no hou ga 〜

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! A は B ほど～ありません matches "Not as much/less than".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is A は B ほど～ありません.
exercises.explanation: Used to say A is not as ~ as B; A is less ~ than B.
